public_rationale: Contemporary reporting supports the importance of cognitive models in Marcus's 2020 article. A September 2019 review also documents related themes in his book. These sources do not establish the full LLM-specific history or the exact one-of-four claim under the restriction against using Marcus's own writing. The word 'perhaps' does not commit him to being first.
limitations: The source restriction excludes direct use of the article whose structure is disputed.

Partial support is not enough to settle the combined historical assertion.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs' difficulty representing world models has been central to Marcus's critiques since 2019, and his 2020 article was perhaps the first lengthy discussion of integrating world models with LLMs.

statement.excerpt: Challenge with LLMs representing world models have been central to my own critiques of LLMs since the fall of 2019, and were one of four key foci in my 2020 article The Next Decade in AI, perhaps the first lengthy discussion of the need for integrating world (cognitive) models specifically with LLMs.
statement.document_title: The False Glorification of Yann LeCun

from_speaker: central to my own critiques of LLMs since the fall of 2019
my 2020 article The Next Decade in AI
our_interpretation: The firm commitments are a substantial recurring theme beginning in fall 2019 and a principal focus among four in the named 2020 article.
Central means a major substantive theme, not necessarily the subject of every critique.
I use September 2019 as the month-level beginning of fall and the post date as the end of the claimed continuing history.
Perhaps first is expressly tentative. It is not scored as a firm claim to priority.
Independent descriptions are required because the task prohibits citing Marcus's own writing as evidence that he was right.
criteria.support_condition: Independent records establish the LLM-specific theme beginning in fall 2019, its continuing prominence, and cognitive models as one of four principal foci in the 2020 article.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records show that the claimed LLM-specific discussion began materially later, or that the named 2020 article lacked the asserted principal focus.
